description: What do LK rows with a Null text and an empty text do under: LIKE Null, NOT LIKE '*', Null LIKE '*', t LIKE '' , t LIKE '*' with Is Null, NOT (t LIKE 'a*'), t LIKE t, a pattern built from the row (Left(t, 1) & '*'), a computed pattern ('*' & ''), the projected truth values of LIKE with Null; and what is the limit on a pattern's length (a pattern of 100, 255, 256 and 500 a's followed by *)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
